name: Get expert user
description: Call this when you need to retrieve the expert user profile associated with the current Brevo account. Use the "meetings.list_offers" action instead if you need a list of meeting offers rather than the expert user details.

id.description: Unique identifier of the expert user.

active.description: Indicates whether the expert user is active (1) or not (0).

hash.description: Unique hash for the expert user.

created.description: Timestamp when the expert user was created.

google_enabled.description: Flag indicating if Google integration is enabled.

microsoft_enabled.description: Flag indicating if Microsoft integration is enabled.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug for the expert user.

is_booking_page_disabled.description: Flag indicating if the booking page is disabled.

page_title.description: Title displayed on the booking page.

page_description.description: Description displayed on the booking page.

use_billing.description: Flag indicating if billing is used.

currency_code.description: Currency code for billing, if applicable.

own_payments.description: Flag indicating if own payments are enabled.

client_dashboard_color.description: Hex color for the client dashboard.

remove_brevo_brand.description: Flag indicating if Brevo branding is removed.

tax_type_id.description: Identifier for the tax type, if set.

has_priced_services.description: Flag indicating if priced services are available.

teams.description: List of teams associated with the expert user.

stripe_payments.description: Flag indicating if Stripe payments are enabled.

simultanous_meetings_limit.description: Maximum number of simultaneous meetings allowed.
